RUNG 4 — Confex's backing JSON API for the 2024 AIChE Annual Meeting: meetingapi.cgi/Program returns 46 top-level division/forum/topical nodes as empty shells; meetingapi.cgi/Program/<id> for each of the 46 IDs returns the full descendant tree with ChildList_Paper populated (e.g. Program/3441, Catalysis and Reaction Engineering Division = 705 papers). REPRODUCE: curl the base Program endpoint for the 46 {Code, Child_DescendantFiles} pairs, extract the numeric id from each, then curl Program/<id> for each and count len(ChildList_Paper). SANITY CHECK: summed the 46 per-division counts (6,947) and independently deduplicated the raw Paper/<id> strings across all 46 divisions (also 6,947) — sum equals the unique-ID count exactly. This also settles the widely-repeated but snippet-only 'over 760 sessions and 6,000 papers' figure (confirmed snippet-only again this pass, via aiche.org's own Cloudflare-blocked CEP recap page) — 6,947 is the exact, countable figure, and it's higher than the rounded snippet.
